_comment: Skin variants per enemy type (schema in Assets/_Game/Editor/EnemyModel/EnemySkinSetup.cs, SkinsDto). Each entry is an FBX skinned to enemy_base's skeleton (same bone names and bind poses); every spawned enemy of that type wears one of its list, picked with equal chance (EnemySkin.cs). Add Assets/_Game/Art/enemy/enemy_base.fbx to a list to keep the original look in the pool; an empty list keeps the base model only. Run Tools > Enemy Model > Setup Enemy Skins (or Rebuild Enemies From Current Model) after editing.
